Summaries.eng: The "heartwarming 'kome'dy with laughter and passion" aims to let the viewers rediscover the goodness of rice; following five handsome rice-inspired boys as they shine at the Kokuritsu Inaho Gakuen's "Harvest Show" live event.
Summaries.jpn:
ハーベストショー。
それは、穀物たちが自身の美味しさを周囲にアピールするライブ。

ハーべスター。
それは、素晴らしいショーをする穀物に捧げられる称号。

減反政策に食の欧米化、穀物の人気がパンに取って代わられた昨今──
食卓は、パンのハーべスター『イーストキング』の独壇場となっていた。

廃校寸前の穀立稲穂学園に入学した新米5人は、
米の人気を取り戻すため『ラブライス』を結成。
イーストキングを超えるべく、ハーベストショーの練習に励む……。

お米を擬人化した、笑いあり・熱血ありのハートフル"米"ディ！
食卓に穀物は２つもいらない。どちらが真のハーべスターとなるのか？

Titles.eng: The Newest Crop of Students Is Here?

Summaries.eng: Somewhere in Japan is the historical school for grains, Inaho Academy. A new student there, Hinohikari, learns at the opening ceremony that the school is about to be shut down, and the only way to stop it is to beat out the bread. With that in mind, Hinohikari declares his intention in front of the whole school to become a HarveStar that surpasses even the alumni group Five Grain Rice...
Summaries.jpn:
日本のどこかにある伝統校「穀立稲穂学園」
新入生のひのひかりは、入学式で学校が廃校になることを知る。
廃校を免れるにはパンに勝つしかない。
そう考えたひのひかりは全校生徒の前で五穀米先輩を超えるH＠rve☆starになろうと伝えるが…。

Titles.jpn: ニコニコ笑顔じゃいられない

Summaries.eng: Hinohikari has decided to enter the Harvest Festival in order to start not a rice boom, but a rice riot. He asks Nikomaru, Akitakomachi, Hitomebore, Sasanishiki, and Chinkobozu to join him, but none of them are willing. Finally Nikomaru can't bear to watch anymore and offers him a surprising suggestion, but can Hinohikari bring himself to take him up on it?
Summaries.jpn:
米ブームならぬ米騒動を起す為に新嘗祭に出場する事を決めたひのひかり
にこまる、あきたこまち、ひとめぼれ、ささにしき、そしてちんこ坊主に声を掛けるも
皆つれない返事ばかり…見兼ねたにこまるから提案があるが果たしてその意外な提案をひのひかりは受け入れる事が出来るのか・・・

Titles.eng: I`ve Had Enough of the Usual Rice Planting
Titles.jpn: 普通の田植えはもうあきた

Summaries.eng: Hinohikari had just grown accustomed to being a member of Nikomaru and Akitakomachi's HarveStar unit, "Blend Mine," when the subject of Akitakomachi's past comes up and they stumble upon a fatal flaw in Blend Mine. So the new unit name suggested by Hinohikari after he had saved it up—no, kept it warm—for a long time is "Love Rice." Meanwhile, Sasanishiki watches the three of them from afar...
Summaries.jpn:
あきたこまち、にこまるのH＠rve☆starユニット「ブレンドマイン」に
加入しハーベストショーに慣れた頃
あきたこまちの過去に触れ、と同時にブレンドマインの致命的な欠点にも気付く。
米を愛するひのひかりが新たなユニット名として名付けた名前…それは彼がずっと温めていたいや保温していた大事な名前「ラブライス」。
そんな彼等を遠くから見つめるささにしきだが・・・。

Titles.eng: Love at First Sight with Hitomebore
Titles.jpn: そんなお前にひとめぼれ

Summaries.eng: The three members of Love Rice are training when they spot Hitomebore hitting on someone. After seeing him so persistently trying to pick up a date even in the middle of a blizzard, Hinohikari asks him to join Love Rice, but Hitomebore says he has plans to become a comedian with Chinkobozu. Then he takes off, saying he has a date, and the Love Rice members follow him to find...
Summaries.jpn:
レッスン中のラブライス3人がナンパをしているひとめぼれを見つける。
吹雪の寒さの中でもナンパし続ける彼を見てひのひかりがラブライスに誘うが、
ちんこ坊主と米ディアンになると言ってきかないひとめぼれ。
彼女とデートがあるからと、その場を立ち去るひとめぼれを追いかけるとなんと…

Titles.eng: Sasanishiki Is Going Home a Hero

Summaries.eng: Sasanishiki continues to refuse the invitations to join Love Rice. Then, for some reason, there's suddenly a train track running through the school yard, and a dog is trapped on the track as a train rushes toward it. Love Rice is frozen in place, but Sasanishiki rushes forward. Sasanishiki's skill and drive when it comes to Harvest Shows was once said to rival Koshihikari himself, but the story Morinokuma begins to tell about his past is one nobody expected...
Summaries.jpn:
ラブライスの加入の誘いを頑なに断り続けるささにしき、
そんな中何故か校庭に現れた線路と犬、そこに差し掛かる電車。
どうする事もできないラブライス達4人だが、とっさにささにしきが動く。
ささにしきのこしひかりにも並ぶと称されるずば抜けたハーベストショーのスキルと、思い。
そんな彼の過去をもりのくまさんから聞き思わぬ真実が飛び出る・・・

Titles.jpn: それゆけイーストキング

Summaries.eng: The five members of Love Rice are both excited and focused as they look ahead to their Harvest Festival appearance. Then An, Shokku, and Kyari, the hottest HarveStars from the Sacred Bread High School, arrive on the scene. After seeing their far superior Harvest Show, the girls who once cheered for Love Rice turn their attention to Yeast King.
Summaries.jpn:
新嘗祭出場を決め、気が引き締まるとともに楽しみにする5人。
そこに突如現れたアン、ショック、キャリー。
今をときめく聖パンハイスクールの競合H＠rve☆starだ。
ラブライスと比べると桁違いのハーベストショーに
今まではラブライスを応援していた女生徒達もイーストキングの魅力にメロメロに・・・

Summaries.eng: The five members of Love Rice are both excited and focused as they look ahead to their Harvest Festival appearance. Then An, Shokku, and Kyari, the hottest HarveStars from the Sacred Bread High School, arrive on the scene. After seeing their far superior Harvest Show, the girls who once cheered for Love Rice turn their attention to Yeast King.
Summaries.jpn:
強烈なインパクトを残していった
イーストキングの影響ですっかりパンブームが来てしまった稲穂学園。
すっかり落ち込むラブライスの前に謎の巨大なおにぎりが現れる。
逃げまわった先に到着した場所は地下H@rve☆starがショーを行うライスハウス。
そこにいたのはなんと憧れの五穀米、その中でも
圧倒的なカリスマ・実力を持つこしひかり先輩・・・しかも6人も！？

Summaries.eng: After feeling stimulated by Blast Resistance's concert, the members of Love Rice try to work on some new moves, but they can't seem to master the perfect technique. As they're left confused and frustrated, Koshihikari, the leader of Five Grain Rice and an alumnus of Inaho Academy, appears before them. Hinohikari, a HarveStar otaku, is enthralled to see his idol standing in front of him, but for the sake of Love Rice, he gets serious about undergoing Koshihikari's rigorous training...
Summaries.jpn:
ブレストレジスタンス達のライブに触発され、新しい技を練習するラブライス。
全く必殺技習得の目処が立たず途方に暮れるメンバーの前に突如現れた五穀米のセンター、
稲穂学園のOBでもあるこしひかり先輩であった。
H＠rve☆starオタクのひのひかりはこしひかり先輩を目の前に米上がるも、
真剣なラブライスの為にこしひかり直々の秘密特訓がはじまる…

Titles.jpn: パンはパンでも食えないパン

Summaries.eng: Hinohikari and Nikomaru sneak into St. Pan High School to scope it out. They end up being caught by Yeast King's homeroom teacher, Crois, but Yeast King puts on their Harvest Show anyway, as if inviting the two of them to check out the competition. After witnessing the overwhelming difference in skill between their two groups, Hinohikari and Nikomaru can't help but respect their rivals. Then Crois comes up with a plan...
Summaries.jpn:
聖パンハイスクールに偵察の為に忍び込むひのひかりとにこまる。
うっかりイーストキング達の担任クロワに見つかってしまうも、
どうぞ偵察していってくれとばかりにハーベストショーを披露するイーストキング。
その圧倒的な力量差を裏付ける志の高い努力を目の当たりにし、
同じH＠rve☆starとして尊敬の念を抱く二人そんな中クロワはある企みを思いつく…

Summaries.eng: Love Rice arrives at the Harvest Festival with the goal of starting a rice riot with their performance, which they haven't once completed successfully in practice yet. Then Hinohikari tells the other members the reason he decided to become a HarveStar. But then the mood is broken when Hitomebore receives a phone call... Who's behind this?!
Summaries.jpn:
練習ではまだ一度も成功していない技を成功させ米騒動を起こす。という目標を掲げ
新嘗祭に乗り込むラブライスたち。ひのひかりは改めてH＠rve☆starを目指すことになった
経緯を話しラブライスメンバーが一つになる。
ところがそんなムードに水をさすような電話がひとめぼれに掛かって来る
一体犯人は誰なんだ・・・！？

Titles.jpn: やっと出たちんこ坊主

Summaries.eng: Love Rice arrives at the Harvest Festival with the goal of starting a rice riot with their performance, which they haven't once completed successfully in practice yet. Then Hinohikari tells the other members the reason he decided to become a HarveStar. But then the mood is broken when Hitomebore receives a phone call... Who's behind this?!
Summaries.jpn:
ひとめぼれがいない中、本番にのぞむことになったラブライス。
本領発揮できていない彼等のハーベストショーに気づき静止するイーストキング。
ラブライス側への妨害、そしてその犯人がコロ姐だったという事を恥じラブライスに
手を貸すイーストキング。敵同士の間に生まれたフェアにハーベストショーを行いたい、
という五穀の心に友情が芽生えはじめる。

Summaries.eng:
Love Rice managed to overcome their crisis thanks to Chinkobozu's Harvest Show. Rain suddenly started to fall as Love Rice made their return to the Harvest Festival venue. Will the wishes of Hinohikari, Sasanishiki, Hitomebore, Akitakomachi, and Nikomaru to restore the popularity of rice and keep the school open be granted? Can rice defeat bread? This emotional Love Kome-dy is about to reach its conclusion!
Love Rice is forced to begin their Harvest Show without Hitomebore, but Yeast King sees that they're not performing at their full potential and stops them. The members of Yeast King feel ashamed of everything they've done to stand in Love Rice's way, and even more so when they find out who was behind Hitomebore's dilemma, so they offer to help. The desire to present their Harvest Shows fair and square leads to the sprouting of friendship between the two rival grains.
Summaries.jpn:
ちんこ坊主のハーベストショーの助けを借り、なんとかピンチを乗り切ったラブライス。
突然の雨が降りしきる新嘗祭の会場に戻るラブライスたち一行。
ひのひかり、ささにしき、ひとめぼれ、あきたこまち、にこまる。
5人の米人気復興、学校存続に懸ける想いは届くのか。
米はパンに勝つ事は出来るのか・・・。感動の学園ラブ米ディがここに完結！

Summaries.eng: Love Rice started a rice riot at the Harvest Festival and became a sensation overnight. They've been super busy with TV appearances, rice planting, and other activities, but the group's leader, Hinohikari, is acting strange... Meanwhile, a new exchange student arrives at Inaho Academy, and he's a ramen HarveStar named Sho. The members of Love Rice can't help feeling flustered by the appearance of a new rival. What will come of the peace that had settled between the grains?

Titles.eng: Based on the Original Concept, Love Rice Is Really Meant to Be Aimed at Girls
Titles.jpn: 当初のコンセプトだとラブ米は一応女子向け

Summaries.eng: Hinohikari had suddenly collapsed in the classroom, worrying the other members of Love Rice. Then, after school, the door bursts open, and a new first-year named Oidemai suddenly puts on a Harvest Show. How will this passionate fan of Love Rice fit into the story? Meanwhile Yeast King, the bread HarveStar unit, is eating out with Love Rice when the waitress asks if they'd prefer bread or rice with their meals. And glaring through the window at their conversation from outside is Sho...

Titles.jpn: スクールハーベスター・ラブライス

Summaries.eng: Morinokuma-san and Koro-nee are getting married. The usual gang is in the audience at the reception, but Hinohikari is nowhere to be found. A comment from Morinokuma-san's students and a Harvest Show by Koshihikari bring the celebration to joyful new heights, until Morinokuma-san gets a phone call...

Titles.eng: The Legendary Six Rice Boys (Mixed Rice)
Titles.jpn: 幻の6人米(シックスライス)
踊り！炊き走査線 The Movie

Summaries.eng: Love Rice is in a celebratory mood after their victory in the Duel and the return of Hinohikari. Then Koshihikari arrives, and he seems troubled. It turns out he's decided to make a movie starring Sasanishiki! Hinohikari, Hitomebore, Akitakomachi, and Nikomaru are all on board, but Sasanishiki is less thrilled. Will they be able to complete the filming?

Titles.eng: The Fake Sho Is Really a Carbohydrate-Free Diet
Titles.jpn: 偽ショウの正体は炭水化物抜きダイエット
